description: Find where an app is, by package name or by name, in one call: whether it is in a policy (its source - Google Play, the Nomid Store Library, a secure web app - its install type and whether it is the kiosk app), in the company's Library, on Google Play (by package name only) and installed on a device (from its last app report). Pass policyId, assetId or both; with assetId alone the device's own policy is checked. "answer" sums it up, and says how the app can be added. Call it before saying an app is or is not somewhere, before adding one, and again whenever the user says an app is there after all: policies and devices change during a conversation. A place this caller cannot read says notChecked: that is not "not there".

assetId.description: A device to check (search_devices' "pathName"): whether its last app report lists the app installed.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

policyId.description: The policy to check, by path name (list_policies' "pathName"). Default: the policy of assetId's device.

query.description: The app's package name (com.example.app; a Play Store link also works) or part of its name ("Phone", "Aumet").

name: find_app
title: Find an app
